cover.sub: It's probably not your willpower. See #5.

reasons.head: Your food is mostly ultra-processed
reasons.sub: It's easy to overeat. In one NIH study, people ate about 500 more calories a day on it.

reasons.head: You eat way too fast
reasons.sub: Eating slowly helped people feel fuller while eating fewer calories at the same meal.

reasons.head: Your meals have no volume
reasons.sub: We tend to eat the same amount of food. Veggies and soups fill that space for fewer calories.

reasons.head: You're stressed all the time
reasons.sub: Stress can push you toward sweet food, especially if your body reacts strongly to it.

reasons.head: You're cutting harder than you think
reasons.sub: Without real numbers it's easy to cut way too much, then crash and overeat.
